Ba cho nay phai hien trong goi Cong 2: chu cua evals.yaml duoc viet TRUOC khi rang ton tai.

decision: Xoa hai assertion goi builderCommandType trong apps/agent/test/custom-agent-runtime.spec.ts, va bo truong message khoi ba loi goi builderSessionAttributes trong ba bai test khac.

Hai assertion bi xoa tung khang dinh: mot message co inputResponse voi commandType CHAT thi van la CHAT. decision: Vong sua sau REJECT r1: (1) ba ma thoat tach bach — 0 xanh, 2 bat bien bi vi pham, 3 gian do hong; chayRang bat MOI ngoai le va tra 3; (2) khoa hoa thao tac git worktree de cac eval chay song song khong dam nhau, bo `worktree prune` toan cuc; (3) chay() khong con nuot loi spawn; (4) E2/E5 co che do tran chay het vecto, va chieu do phai neu TEN BAI TEST dung phai do — thoi tu in chuoi ghim o nhanh thanh cong; (5) E4 so danh sach CO BOI (bo Set) nen mot cho ghi thu hai trong cung ham khong con vo hinh.
impact: Nguyen nhan goc cua E8 do: cong-quyen-do.mjs chet bang mot ngoai le chua bat, Node thoat 1 — TRUNG dung ma da khai cho «dot bien bi giet» — nen chi phep kiem chuoi ghim cuu. Ma 3 rieng cho gian do hong lam ca lop lech nay khong con lot duoc. Khong sua cac muc triage khai inContract:false; chung di Cong 2.

decision: DUNG theo dieu khoan dung-va: khong tu dispatch vong cham thu ba. Dua ba duong cho nguoi chon.
impact: Hai vong lien tiep co mot phep do bao DO ma khong phai vi vat do sai: r1/E8 (rang chet bang ngoai le, Node thoat 1 trung ma da khai cho dot-bien-bi-giet) va r2/E5 (rang thoat 0 tren may, output nguoi cham chep lai chinh la output nhanh THANH CONG, nhung ho ghi exitCode 1). Cung mot lop: KET QUA DUOC BAO cua mot phep do khong phai ket qua THAT cua no. Con mot finding HIGH trong hop dong chua sua: nguon-ghi.mjs mu voi upsert / updateMany / data-la-bien.
revisit: Nguoi chon: doi khuon (rang thoi do bang lenh ngoai, chuyen sang bai test that trong suite) · thu pham vi (bo E5 khoi vong nay) · ship voi gioi han da biet.

decision: Owner chon duong THU PHAM VI. Hai doi trong hop dong: (1) AC-3 doi dan so tu «object data cua loi goi Prisma» sang «moi cho VIET RA khoa commandType», so co boi; (2) AC-4 bo chan do rieng cho chieu do — chieu do do ban khai sinh (AC-7) ganh, chieu xanh dung lenh may co san ql_quyen_ke_thua cua ho so truoc.
impact: Loai hai duong con lai (doi khuon: viet lai sau rang thanh bai test that; ship voi gioi han da biet). Doi (1) dong lo HIGH ma vong cham 2 chung minh bang cay thu: khung theo-hinh-dang bo sot upsert (khong co khoa data), updateMany, va data la bien — ba dang deu ghim cung CREATE_AGENT ma van xanh. Dan so moi la 9 cho, on dinh hon 178 loi goi ghi trong do 31 cho khung cu khong doc noi payload. Doi (2) bo mot duong do da hai lan bao ket qua khong phai ket qua that cua no. Doi lai: hai thay doi nay la DOI PHAM VI cua hop dong da ky, nen phai duyet lai Cong 1 truoc khi cham vong 3.

decision: DUNG o tran ba vong. Chan doan da du bang chung: rang nao IN OUTPUT cua luot bun test da dot bien ra stdout cua chinh no thi lan cham doc dong tong ket "N fail" ay va bao eval do, bat ke ma thoat.
impact: Vong 2 dinh E5 (mang-theo-do), vong 3 dinh E2 (cong-quyen-do) — cung hinh dang, va viec bo E5 o vong 3 chi lam lo do CHUYEN sang rang con lai. Ca hai lan chay tay deu thoat 0 va dong cuoi stdout la dong thanh cong. Cach chua re: rang thoi in nguyen output cua luot dot bien, chi in mot ban rut gon (ten bai da do + so dem), de khong con dong "N fail" nao trong stdout cua rang. Chua thu: 7 finding trong hop dong, trong do hai HIGH cung mot lop — san AST chi nhan MOT cach viet cua khoa (vong 2: upsert/updateMany/data-la-bien; vong 3: khoa viet bang string literal hoac computed key).
revisit: Nguoi quyet: (a) sua cach in cua rang roi cham lai; (b) doi khuon san AST; (c) ship voi gioi han da biet.

Ghi chu: toi da tu chon cau hinh phien thang luat kho o S2 va chi khai no trong ke hoach thay vi hoi — dang ra phai dua nguoi quyet ngay luc gap.

decision: Ba sua sau vong cham 3: (1) hai rang chay bun test thoi in NGUYEN output cua luot dot bien, chi in ban rut gon co mang ten bai phai do; (2) san AC-3 nhan ca khoa viet bang string literal va computed key; (3) san AC-2 len BON dieu — them ma tran khoa cho apps/agent, siet dieu 3 thanh <dinh danh>.commandType mot tang, va dieu 2 bat ca export doi ten lan method cung ten.

Kiem lai: stdout gio khong con dong N fail nao. (2) va (3) dong ba lo nguoi soi da dung cay thu chung minh la lot. Vecto len 18. Doi lai: (2) va (3) doi noi dung phep do nen phai duyet lai Cong 1 lan hai.

decision: Nguoi TRA LAI o Cong 2: sua hai muc HIGH trong hop dong truoc khi ky. Khong truong ky nao duoc ghi, verdict khong nang, hop dong ve implemented.

Ca hai da duoc dung cay thu chung minh, deu thoat 0.

decision: Sua hai muc HIGH: (1) tenKhoa() giai duoc computed key tro toi mot HANG CHUOI trong cung tep; (2) loaiCua() cua nguon-ghi.mjs doi goc la DINH DANH TRAN, cung luat voi laTruyCapTran cua san AC-2. Them ba vecto: khoa-hang-chuoi, goc-khong-tran, khoa-hang-chuoi-agent. Vecto len 21.
impact: Ca ba probe nguoi soi dung de chung minh lo nay deu doi tu thoat 0 sang ma 2. Chu cua AC-3 duoc SIET cho khop: loai `khai` nay doi `<mot dinh danh tran>.commandType`, dung nhu AC-2 diem 3 von da doi — day la thu hep, khong phai noi, nen di thang vong cham theo dung luat cua lenh ky (tra lai -> ve vong sua/cham). Va khai them mot GIOI HAN: computed key ma bieu thuc khong truy duoc ve mot hang chuoi cung tep thi san khong doc duoc ten khoa; hai dan so co 19 va 11 cai nhu the, deu la khoa cot dong hop le. Chan het chung la dung them mot may phat do-oan, nen vong nay khai thang phan chua phu thay vi giau.

decision: DUNG. Khong tu dispatch vong cham 6. Chan doan cua toi o vong 4 la SAI: bo echo N fail khong chua duoc gi, vong 5 van ghi E2 exit 1 trong khi chay tay thoat 0 va output sach.
impact: Ba lan, hai rang khac nhau (r2 mang-theo-do, r3 va r5 cong-quyen-do). Bo mot rang thi loi chuyen sang rang con lai. Day la khuon giai sai chu khong phai chi tiet sai — dieu khoan dung-va da chay mot lan cho lop nay, va ban sua theo huong da chon KHONG dong duoc no. Rieng phan sua hai muc HIGH cua Cong 2 thi CO tac dung: ba probe cua nguoi soi doi tu thoat 0 sang ma 2.
